    # Defensive defaults
    player = observation.get("player_id", 0)
    pos = observation.get("position", (0, 0))
    x, y = pos if isinstance(pos, (list, tuple)) and len(pos) >= 2 else (0, 0)

    # Heuristic: attempt to stay near center of map if size provided, else stay moderate
    # Use available map bounds if provided
    grid = observation.get("grid", {})
    width = grid.get("width", 0)
    height = grid.get("height", 0)

    # Prefer staying within bounds and moving towards center when possible
    center_x = (width - 1) / 2 if width else x
    center_y = (height - 1) / 2 if height else y

    dx = 0
    dy = 0

    # Move toward center if close to edge or if interesting resources not detected
    if width and height:
        if x < center_x:
            dx = 1
        elif x > center_x:
            dx = -1
        else:
            dx = 0

        if y < center_y:
            dy = 1
        elif y > center_y:
            dy = -1
        else:
            dy = 0
    else:
        # If no map size, make small deterministic exploration around current pos
        dy = 0
        dx = 1 if (x + y) % 2 == 0 else -1

    # Defensive adjustment if there are resources nearby
    resources = observation.get("resources", [])
    if resources:
        # If there is a resource at adjacent cell, try to move toward it
        for r in resources:
            rx, ry = r.get("position", (x, y)) if isinstance(r, dict) else (x, y)
            if abs(rx - x) <= 1 and abs(ry - y) <= 1:
                dx = int((rx - x))
                dy = int((ry - y))
                # clamp to -1..1
                if dx < -1: dx = -1
                if dx > 1: dx = 1
                if dy < -1: dy = -1
                if dy > 1: dy = 1
                return [dx, dy]

    # If pursuing another agent or avoiding, use simple avoidance: avoid moving off-grid if bounds known
    if width and height:
        nx, ny = x + dx, y + dy
        nx = max(0, min(width - 1, nx))
        ny = max(0, min(height - 1, ny))
        dx = nx - x
        dy = ny - y

    return [dx, dy]
